# GetShortlisted

> GetShortlisted (getshortlisted.in) is an India-focused career service that gets job seekers shortlisted on Naukri.com: it optimizes Naukri profiles and resumes so candidates appear in recruiter searches, and can also run the whole Naukri job search and apply to jobs on the candidate's behalf. Independent service — not affiliated with Naukri.com or Info Edge (India) Ltd.

Key facts:
- Plans: Profile Makeover — ₹6,000 (Naukri profile optimization + ATS-friendly resume, handed over to the candidate). Done-For-You Job Search — ₹8,000 (everything in Profile Makeover + Naukri profile management + job applications on the candidate's behalf).
- Every plan starts with a free profile check; payment only after the candidate chooses a plan.
- Naukri profile optimization covers: resume headline, key skills, profile summary, employment details, projects, desired career profile, keyword research for role and city.
- Who it is for: freshers and experienced professionals across India, IT and non-IT roles, people on notice period, after layoffs, career switchers and those with career gaps.
- How it works: candidate uploads resume and shares Naukri login email/mobile on the website -> free profile check -> WhatsApp follow-up -> optimization (and applications on Done-For-You) -> recruiter calls typically start within about a week (not guaranteed).
- Passwords are never collected on the website; Naukri account access is arranged privately on WhatsApp after a plan is chosen. No fake experience is added.
- Contact: WhatsApp (button on the site), hello@getshortlisted.in, or the form at https://getshortlisted.in/contact/

## Services & pricing
- [Plans & pricing](https://getshortlisted.in/pricing/): Profile Makeover ₹6,000 vs Done-For-You Job Search ₹8,000.
- [Naukri Profile Optimization](https://getshortlisted.in/naukri-profile-optimization/): What is optimized in a Naukri profile and why keywords decide recruiter visibility.
- [Naukri Job Application Service](https://getshortlisted.in/naukri-job-application-service/): Done-for-you job search — we manage the Naukri profile and apply to matching jobs for the candidate.
- [ATS-Friendly Resume Writing](https://getshortlisted.in/resume-optimization/): Keyword-optimized resume writing for Indian job seekers.
